    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    rs=[r for r,row in enumerate(grid) if 5 in row]
    cs=[c for c in range(len(grid[0])) if any(row[c]==5 for row in grid)]
    top,bottom=min(rs),max(rs)
    left,right=min(cs),max(cs)

        r1,r2=top+layer,bottom-layer
        c1,c2=left+layer,right-layer

            out[r1][c]=color
            out[r2][c]=color
        for r in range(r1,r2+1):

            out[r][c2]=color
